title: Kiangnan Tseng Pao - A Japanese Newspaper In The Chinese Language

June 4, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

The Metropolis(大都會), a mosquito paper, publishes the following article :-

ARREST OF A MOVIE ACTRESS

Wong Ying (王瑩), a Chinese movie actress, returned here from Japan several months ago. After her arrival, certain persons suggested that she be given the principal part in a film to be known as "Jung Tse Tsao" (人之初), directed by Sz Tung Sen (史東山). She refused the part because she did not care to play the part of an old woman. In reality, her refusal had been instigated by Sung Tuan Sien (沈端先) and other "leftists" because Sz Tung Sen had once rejected a certain demand from the Chinese Communist Party.

Subsequently, Wong Ying joined the Dien Tung (電通) Film Company which is the headquarters of red elements. She was starred in a film entitled "The Goddess of Liberty" (自由神). The story was written by Sung Tuan Sien.

According to reliable information, Wong Ying was arrested on the morning of June 3 at her home on Route Vallen, French Concession. The cause of her arrest is unknown.

The Iron News (鐵報), a mosquito paper, publishes the following article :-

KIANGNAN TSUNG PAO SUSPENDS PUBLICATION

There is published in this locality a newspaper called the "Kiangnan Tsung Pao" (江南正報) which is a disgrace to the Chinese people in Shanghai. The promoters of this paper are Japanese.

It publishes matters in favour of the Japanese and Manchukuo but against the Chinese Government. In view of the support given by the Japanese, the paper was openly distributed in the Settlements.

A person who has some knowledge of the organization of this publication states that all the staff members of the paper are Chinese and that some of the editors are university students. It is regrettable that these Chinese university students should be working for a Japanese owned paper which publishes news attacking the Chinese Government. A considerable number of advertisements appear in the paper and the Japanese and Manchukuo authorities have been assisting the paper with large sums of money.

Since June 1 the paper has not appeared in Shanghai. From enquiries made among Japanese circles, this paper has suspended business but the reason of the suspension is unknown. If an enquiry is made by telephone, the reply will be that the paper has ceased publication and that no further issues will appear.

1935年6月4日。下午译文。

《大都会》（The Metropolis），一份小型报刊，刊登了以下文章：-

电影女演员被捕

中国电影女演员王瑩（Wong Ying）数月前从日本返回此地。抵达后，有人建议由她在史東山（Sz Tung Sen）导演的名为《人之初》（Jung Tse Tsao）的影片中担任主角。她拒绝了该角色，因为她不愿扮演老妇人的角色。实际上，她的拒绝是由沈端先（Sung Tuan Sien）和其他“左翼分子”唆使的，因为史東山曾拒绝中国共产党的某项要求。

随后，王瑩加入了作为红色分子总部的电通（Dien Tung）影片公司。她在一部名为《自由神》（The Goddess of Liberty）的影片中担任主演。该剧本由沈端先编写。

据可靠消息，王瑩于6月3日上午在法租界华伦路（Route Vallen）的家中被捕。被捕原因不明。

《铁报》（The Iron News），一份小型报刊，刊登了以下文章：-

《江南正报》停刊

本地出版有一份名为《江南正报》（Kiangnan Tsung Pao）的报纸，这是上海中国人的耻辱。该报的发起人是日本人。

该报刊登亲日本和满洲国但反对中国政府的内容。鉴于日本方面的支持，该报在租界内公开分发。

一位对该出版物组织情况有所了解的人士称，该报所有工作人员均为中国人，其中部分编辑为大学生。令人遗憾的是，这些中国大学生竟在为一家刊登攻击中国政府新闻的日本_owned_报纸工作。该报刊登了大量广告，日本和满洲国当局一直向该报提供巨额资金援助。

自6月1日以来，该报未在上海出现。经向日本方面查询，该报已停止营业，但停办原因不明。若通过电话查询，得到的答复是该报已 cease publication（停止出版），不再发行后续期号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch S. 5. **〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及档案号部分〕**
No. D 3486
REPORT
Date January 7, 1935

Subject Kiangnan Tseng Pao - a Japanese newspaper in the Chinese language.

Made by __________ and __________ Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

The "Kiangnan Tseng Pao" (江南正报) is a
Japanese newspaper printed and published in the Chinese
language at 214 Range Road. It is not for sale publicly
but has a private circulation among local Japanese. The
policy of the paper is to propagate news in favour of
Japan and Manchukuo. Articles from Japanese newspapers
with some additions are generally reproduced (translation "A").
An office which arranges for the registration of trade
marks in Manchukuo is situated in the office of the paper
(translation "B").
The paper is now being obtained free of charge due
to an arrangement made by D.S. Umemoto with the management.
Articles of interest appearing from time to time will be
duly translated.

（批：8/2）

D. S. I.

v D. C. (Special Branch).
File
JAS

主题 《江南正报》——一份中文日文报纸。

由 ___ 和 ___ 制作，由副督察长邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）转发。

《江南正报》（Kiangnan Tseng Pao）是一份
在日本人控制下，以中文印刷和出版
的报纸，地址为兰路（Range Road）214号。该报不公开
出售，但在当地日本人中私下流传。该报
的方针是宣传有利于日本和满洲国的新闻。通常
转载日本报纸的文章并稍作增补（译文“A”）。
该报社内设有一个办理满洲国商标
注册的办事处（译文“B”）。
由于梅本副督察（D.S. Umemoto）与管理层达成的安排，
目前可免费获取该报。不时出现的感兴趣的文章
将及时翻译。

（批注：8/2）

副督察长

致 警司（特务科）。

December 2, 1934. Morning Translation.

Modern Daily News (時代日報), a mosquito paper, dated Nov. 30:

THE KIANGNAN TSENG PAO

Of all the local Chinese newspapers the
"Kiangnan Tseng Pao" (江南正報) is a disgrace to local
Chinese. This publication at first conducted propaganda
in favour of Japan. Recently it has been publishing,
on behalf of Manchukuo, articles opposing Soviet Russia.
This paper is on sale in the Yangtszepoo
District only because many Japanese reside in that
district and the influence of the Japanese policemen
there is very great. For this reason, the sale of the
publication has not been interfered with.
The non-recognition of Manchukuo was
stipulated in resolutions passed by the League of
Nations and all the nations in the world have refused
to recognise the bogus state.
Shanghai is a part of the territory of China
and the foreign Settlements are residential areas
rented temporarily to foreigners. We do not know
whether the authorities have devised any measures to
deal with the paper which is representing Manchukuo.

（左侧手写批注：）
$5,
Do we
get the
Kiangnan
Tseng Pao? What
other articles
were published?
MB

1934年12月2日。上午译文。

《时代日报》（Modern Daily News），一份小型报刊，11月30日刊：

《江南正报》

在所有本地中文报纸中，《江南正报》（Kiangnan Tseng Pao）是本地中国人的耻辱。该出版物起初进行亲日宣传。最近，它代表满洲国刊登反对苏联俄罗斯的文章。
该报仅在杨树浦地区销售，因为许多日本人居住在该区，且当地日本警察的影响力非常大。因此，该出版物的销售未受干涉。
国际联盟通过的决议规定不承认满洲国，世界各国均拒绝承认这个伪政权。
上海是中国领土的一部分，而外国租界是暂时出租给外国人居住的区域。我们不知当局是否已制定任何措施来对付这份代表满洲国的报纸。

（左侧手写批注：）

December 17, 1934.
Afternoon Translation

The Kiang Nan Tseng Pao (江南正報), a Japanese
organ, publishes the following comment:-

BRITAIN CHANGES HER POLICY TOWARD CHINA

China has a wide territory and a dense population,
but she is unable to cultivate the land or develop
herself through her own efforts. She relies on others
to devise measures for her. Hence, the European and
American capitalists and imperialists are regarding China
as a big, fat piece of meat and are striving to have a
piece of it. China has thus become a sub-colony.
During the present difficult times in China,
the most important question affecting the people is
England's change in her policy of economic invasion in
China.
Since England's annexation of Hongkong by means
of big warships and guns, Britain has used it as a base
for economic invasion in South China, the Yangtze Valley
and North China.
Owing to the difficulties which have arisen since
the World War, England has adopted a negative attitude
in the preservation of her rights and interests which
she has already acquired in China. As she has not
yet resorted to positive measures in her encroachment
upon China, the Chinese people have forgotten the British
invasion, and are now regarding England as a friend. But
England has not forgotten, for she is now waiting for a
suitable opportunity.
Of late the Chinese people have been unanimously
demanding national salvation by means of aviation, the
development of the North-West and other things. This
provides an excellent opportunity for European and
American capitalists and imperialists to advance their
economic invasion in China. England will not be behind
in this invasion. China has a wide and desolate
territory in the North-West. The cultivation of the
North-West is just what the British desire, because
England can turn it into a colony for her people who can
work the natural resources of the North-West. It will
add to Britain's wealth. Hence, Szechuen, Sikong,
Chinghai, Singkiang, Mongolia and Thibet may all be
placed under the British economic sphere of influence.
England is hastening the completion of the Canton-Hankow
Railway so that British goods can be conveniently
distributed from Hongkong to Canton, thence to Central
China and all the provinces along the Yangtze River.
The Peiping-Hankow Railway carries British goods to North
China.
At present, the British Minister is busily
negotiating with the Nanking and the South-West authorities
for the development of British economic influence in
South China and in the North-West. If his efforts
prove successful, the North-Western and the Southern parts
of China will be held by England although they may remain,
in name only, as Chinese territory.
page_data.zh:
1934年12月17日。
下午译文

《江南正报》（Kiang Nan Tseng Pao），一份日本
机构刊物，发表了以下评论：-

英国改变对华政策

中国幅员辽阔，人口稠密，
但她无法通过自身努力耕种土地或发展
自己。她依赖他人为其制定措施。因此，欧美
资本家和帝国主义者将中国视为一块肥美的
肉，并争相分食。中国 thus 成为了一个半殖民地。
在中国目前的困难时期，
影响民众的最重要问题是
英国改变其对华经济侵略政策。
自从英国凭借大型战舰和大炮吞并香港以来，
英国便将其作为在华南、长江流域
和华北进行经济侵略的基地。
由于世界大战后出现的困难，英国
在维护其已在中国获得的权益方面采取了消极态度。
由于她尚未采取积极措施侵华，
中国人民已忘记了英国的侵略，现在将英国视为朋友。但
英国并未忘记，因为她正在等待合适的时机。
近来，中国人民一致要求通过航空、开发
西北等方式救国。这为欧美
资本家和帝国主义者推进在华经济侵略提供了绝佳机会。英国
在此次侵略中不会落后。中国西北拥有广阔而荒凉的
领土。开发西北正是英国人所渴望的，因为
英国可以将其变为殖民地，供其人民开采西北的
自然资源。这将增加英国的财富。因此，四川、西康、
青海、新疆、蒙古和西藏都可能被纳入
英国的经济势力范围。
英国正加紧完成粤汉铁路的建设，以便英国货物
能方便地从香港运至广州，再运往华中及长江沿岸各省。
平汉铁路则将英国货物运往华北。
目前，英国公使正忙于与南京及西南当局谈判，
以发展英国在华南和西北的经济影响力。如果他的努力
取得成功，虽然中国西北和南部地区在名义上仍
为中国领土，但实际上将被英国掌控。

page_data.en:
December 28, 1934.    Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

MAINICHI

COMMUNIST FAR EASTERN MEETING TO BE HELD IN SHANGHAI.
CHINESE COMMUNISTS ARE ACTIVE: POLICE AUTHORITIES
KEEP CLOSE WATCH

It is reported that a Far
Eastern Communist General meeting will be held in Shanghai
in accordance with the decision reached at the 13th
General meeting of the Komintern held at Moscow in
November 1934. The meeting may be known as the "General
meeting of Far Eastern Anti-Imperialists" or "Grand
meeting of Communist representatives in the Far East."
According to intelligence
reports received at a certain quarter, the meeting will
be held at a certain place in Shanghai at the end of this
year or beginning of 1935. Three representatives
including Pasitsury(?) and Kuriposhocw(?) of the Head-
quarters of the Komintern, carrying certain important
instructions with them, secretly arrived in Shanghai in
the beginning of this month. They met a lady named
Makury(?), international Red adherent who arrived here
from the South Sea Islands, Madame Sun Yat-Sen, who is a
well known fighter of the anti-Imperialists and anti-
war movement, and Chen Hsao Wu, Chief secretary of the
Central Secretariat of the Chinese Communist Party, to
make arrangements for the meeting. A Number of
representatives of various communist parties, anti-Imperialist
League and Labour Unions have arrived here from various
places in the Far East. The intelligence section of
the Bureau of Public Safety and the Chinese Defence
Commissioner's Headquarters are actively engaged in
dealing with the activities of the communists while the
authorities of the S.M.C. and the F.M.C. are maintaining
close cooperation in the matter.
The object of the meeting in
question is reported to be the laying of a plan to
bolshevise the Far East and the World by giving full
assistance to the Chinese Red Wheel Movement. The
great changes which have taken place in the Far East owing
to the establishment of Manchukuo and the development of
the Naval Conference will be taken full advantage of.
The Chinese Red Army is now moving towards the South
and has found a stronghold in South Szechuen. It is
only a question of time for the Chinese Reds to establish
a strong Soviet in the provinces of the North and South
in cooperation with the Reds in Outer Mongolia and the
Northern Part of Sinkiang. Anticipating brighter
prospects for the Chinese Reds, other communists in various
countries in the Far East are becoming very active.
page_data.zh:
1934年12月28日。    上午译文。

杂项

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

共产党远东会议将在上海举行。
中国共产党人活动频繁：警方当局
严密监视

据报道，根据1934年11月在莫斯科举行的共产国际第13次代表大会的决定，将在上海举行远东共产党全体会议。该会议可能被称为“远东反帝主义者全体会议”或“远东共产党代表大会”。
根据某方面收到的情报报告，会议将于今年年底或1935年初在上海某地举行。包括帕西楚里(?)（Pasitsury?）和库里波肖克(?)（Kuriposhocw?）在内的三名共产国际总部代表，携带某些重要指示，于本月初秘密抵达上海。他们会见了从南洋群岛抵达此地的国际红色拥护者马库里女士(?)（Makury?）、著名的反帝和反战运动斗士孙逸仙夫人，以及中共中央秘书处秘书长陈绍武（Chen Hsao Wu），以安排会议事宜。多名来自远东各地的共产党各党派、反帝同盟和工会的代表已抵达此地。公安局情报科和中国防卫专员总部正积极处理共产党人的活动，而工部局和公董局当局在此事上保持密切合作。
据悉，上述会议的目的是制定计划，通过全力援助中国红军运动，使远东和世界布尔什维克化。将充分利用因满洲国建立和海军会议发展而在远东发生的巨大变化。
中国红军正向南方移动，并在川南建立了据点。中国红色分子与外蒙古和新疆北部的红色分子合作，在南北各省建立强大的苏维埃政权只是时间问题。鉴于中国红色分子前景看好，远东各国其他共产党人变得非常活跃。

December 29, 1934. Morning Translation

The Kiangnan Tseng Iao(江南正报), a Japanese newspaper
published in the Chinese language, contains the following
article :-

THE THIRD INTERNATIONALE TO HOLD FAR EASTERN MEETING
IN SHANGHAI AT YEAR END TO REDDEN CHINA, TO FOUND A
NEW BASE BY ESTABLISHING CLOSE TOUCH WITH OUTER
MONGOLIA AND THE SOVIET UNION, TO DISRUPT THE ECONOMIC
RELATIONS BETWEEN FOREIGN POWERS AND CHINA, AND TO SET
UP A SOVIET REGIME.

While the main forces of the Chinese Red
Army are shifting to the province of Szechuen with a
view to establishing a new base linking with Outer
Mongolia and the Soviet Union, the Third Internationale
is making plans to convene in Shanghai by the end of
this year a general meeting of representatives of the
various communist parties, anti-imperialist league and
Leftist organisations of Far Eastern countries, such
as China, Japan, India, Korea, the Philippine Islands,
Indo-China and the South Seas.
Three representatives of the Third Inter-
nationale, including Pasitsury(?) and Kuriposhoow(?),
secretly arrived in Shanghai in the beginning of this
month. Miss Makury(?), a female international red
movement worker, arrived here from the South Seas in
the middle of this month. They are now discussing
preparations with Madame Sun Yat Sen and the leaders
of the Chinese Communist Party.
Delegates from the various countries are
arriving here. Representatives from the Chinese
Soviet Government, the Anti-Imperialist League, the
Chinese Red Army, the Chinese People's Armed Self-
Defence Committee and auxiliary organs of the Chinese
Communist Party will attend the general meeting.

Name of the General Meeting.

The forthcoming general meeting will be
known as "The Far Eastern Anti-Imperialist and Anti-
War Congress" or as "General Meeting of Representatives
of International Revolutionary Bodies in the Far East."

Object of the Meeting.

The Third Internationale regards China as
a base for the world revolutionary war on the following
grounds :-
1) China has enormous resources and a large
population. She is the biggest raw materials market
of the international capitalists. She is the only
semi-colonial State that has not yet been dismembered.
Therefore, the reddening of China and the establishment
of a soviet regime will disrupt the economic relations
between the foreign Powers and China and will deprive
the former of a big market. This will be the quickest
path to a world communist revolution.

1934年12月29日。晨间译件

《江南正报》（Kiangnan Tseng Iao），一份以中文出版的日文报纸，刊登了以下文章：-

第三国际将于年底在上海召开远东会议，旨在使中国“赤化”，通过与外蒙古和苏联建立密切联系来建立新基地，破坏列强与中国的经济关系，并建立苏维埃政权。

鉴于中国红军主力正向四川省转移，以期建立与外蒙古和苏联相连的新基地，第三国际正计划于今年年底在上海召开一次大会，与会者包括中国、日本、印度、朝鲜、菲律宾群岛、印度支那和南洋等远东国家的各共产党、反帝同盟及左翼组织的代表。

本月月初，包括 Pasitsury(?) 和 Kuriposhoow(?) 在内的三名第三国际代表秘密抵达上海。一名名为 Makury(?) 的女士，系国际红色运动工作人员，于本月月中旬从南洋抵达此地。他们目前正与孙逸仙夫人及中国共产党领导人商讨筹备工作。

各国代表正陆续抵达此处。来自中华苏维埃政府、反帝同盟、中国红军、中国人民武装自卫委员会以及中国共产党辅助机构的代表将出席此次大会。

大会名称。

即将召开的大会将命名为“远东反帝反战大会”或“远东国际革命团体代表大会”。

会议目标。

第三国际基于以下理由视中国为世界革命战争的基地：-
1) 中国拥有巨大的资源和庞大的人口。它是国际资本家最大的原材料市场。它是唯一尚未被瓜分的半殖民地国家。因此，使中国“赤化”并建立苏维埃政权，将破坏列强与中国的经济关系，并使前者失去一个大市场。这将是通往世界共产主义革命的最快途径。

page_data.en:
A4
December 29, 1934. Morning Translation

2) Conditions in the Far East have greatly
changed since the inauguration of Manchukuo. Using
China as a base to redden the Far East, the Soviet
Union will energetically assist the Chinese Red Army,
strengthen the red regime in Outer Mongolia and support
Ma Chung Ying(馬仲英) to establish a red base in
Sinkiang. The invasion of Kweichow and Szechuen by
the Chinese Red Army will cause the great North-West
to fall into the hands of the Red Army.
3) International relations on the Pacific
are becoming strained and the Soviet Union has decided
to take this opportunity to sovietize China.

New War Tactics.

At the 13th Plenary Session of the Third
Internationale held in November this year, the following
resolutions which have already been published in a
recent issue of the "Red Flag", a communist organ paper,
relating to the Chinese revolution were passed:-
(1) Consolidation of communist parties in colonial and

April 25, 1932. Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

The Kiangnan Chenpao ( a Japanese newspaper
published in Chinese) contains the following comment: -

JAPAN AND THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS.

The Administrative Council of the League of
Nations is formed by the delegates of Britain, France,
Japan and Italy who have the power to enforce the League
Convenant. Consequently, the authority of these four nations
represents the authority of the League of Nations.
The League Convenant, which was designed to
assure the peace of the world, is really an empty document
as the following will show: In August, 1923, an Italian
General led a League Commission to investigate the war
between Greece and Albania. Mistaking ... the Italian
General to be pro-Albania in sentiment, the Greeks murdered
him. Mussolini, the Premier of Italy lodged a protest
with Greece and submitted 7 demands, three of which Greece
could not accept. Whereupon, the Italian Navy occupied the
Greek island of Corfu. When Greece appealed to the League
of Nations, the Italian delegate announced that the affair
affected the prestige of Italy and that the League should
not interfere. The result was that the League appointed
the Ministers of Britain, France, Japan and Italy to
settle the trouble.
The Far Eastern question is not so simple
as that and to wait for the League of Nations to settle
it is a very stupid mistake indeed.
Japan fully apprehends the emptiness and
weakness of the League and it is not without reason that
she is contemplating her withdrawal from the League.

杂项

《江南正报》（一份以中文出版的日文报纸）刊登了以下评论：-

日本与国际联盟。

国际联盟行政院由拥有执行《国联盟约》权力的英国、法国、日本和意大利代表组成。因此，这四个国家的权威代表了国际联盟的权威。
旨在确保世界和平的《国联盟约》，实际上是一纸空文，如下所示：1923年8月，一位意大利将军率领国联调查团调查希腊与阿尔巴尼亚之间的战争。希腊人误以为...这位意大利将军亲阿尔巴尼亚，遂将其谋杀。意大利总理墨索里尼向希腊提出抗议，并提出7项要求，其中三项希腊无法接受。于是，意大利海军占领了希腊科孚岛。当希腊向国际联盟申诉时，意大利代表宣布此事关乎意大利的威望，国联不应干涉。结果是，国联任命英国、法国、日本和意大利的大臣来解决这一纠纷。
远东问题并非如此简单，等待国际联盟来解决确实是一个非常愚蠢的错误。
日本充分领会到国联的空虚和软弱，其考虑退出国联并非没有理由。
